prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1432; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim file for that.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot in Baytown, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main entrance.

Q: What happened as you were pulling out?

A: I checked my mirror and didn't see anything, so I started backing out slowly. Then a vehicle came down the aisle and hit the rear driver's side of my car. It wasn't going very fast, but it was enough to jolt me.

Q: Did you see the other driver before the impact?

A: No. I think they were looking for a spot and didn't see me either.

Q: Were you injured?

A: My lower back hurt right away. It's a strain, I think. I felt a sharp pain when I turned to look over my shoulder, and it's been sore since.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day. They gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and follow up with my regular doctor.

Q: Did you miss any work because of the injury?

A: I missed about two days, and I've been limited in lifting at my job since then.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was careful backing out. I want my car repaired and my medical bills covered.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
